responses: Welcome to Poornasree AI! I am your personal assistant for Poornasree milk testing equipment. I can help you understand your product, walk you through setup, and guide you if something is not working. What would you like to explore today?

A milk analyzer is a device that measures the quality parameters of milk instantly. Poornasree analyzers can measure Fat, SNF (Solids-Not-Fat), CLR, Protein, and more — all in seconds. This helps dairy farmers, milk collection centers, and cooperatives test milk quality right at the source. Would you like to know about a specific model?

The VIBRO Milk Analyzer Stirrer is a motorized stirrer attachment for milk cans. It mixes milk uniformly before testing so your analyzer gives accurate readings every time. Without proper stirring, cream separation can cause wrong results. The VIBRO stirrer ensures consistent mixing in about 10-15 seconds. It is compatible with most Poornasree analyzers.

When you unbox your Poornasree equipment, here is what you should find: (1) The main unit (analyzer/stirrer/adapter), (2) Power adapter or charger, (3) Sample cups or beakers, (4) User manual with warranty card, (5) Cleaning brush or cotton swabs, (6) Calibration liquid or standard solution (for analyzers). If anything is missing, please share a photo of the package and we will arrange a replacement.

Here is a simple getting-started guide: Step 1 -- Place the analyzer on a clean, flat surface away from direct sunlight. Step 2 -- Connect the power adapter and switch on the unit. Step 3 -- Wait for the self-test to complete (the display should show ready). Step 4 -- Pour a milk sample into the sample cup and place it in the analyzer. Step 5 -- Stir the milk well using the VIBRO stirrer before testing. Step 6 -- Press the TEST button and wait for the result. If any step is unclear, just ask!

Calibration ensures your analyzer gives accurate results. Use the standard calibration liquid provided with the unit. Step 1 -- Pour calibration liquid into a clean sample cup. Step 2 -- Place it in the analyzer and run the test. Step 3 -- Compare the displayed value with the standard value on the bottle. Step 4 -- If they match, your device is calibrated. If not, adjust using the calibration buttons. We recommend calibrating once every 15 days for best accuracy.

Each product is designed for Indian dairy conditions with rugged build quality and easy maintenance. Ask about any specific product for details!

Here is a simple milk testing guide: Step 1 -- Take a clean sample cup and fill it with milk (about 30-50ml). Step 2 -- Stir the milk thoroughly using the VIBRO stirrer for 10-15 seconds. Step 3 -- Pour the stirred milk into the analyzer cup and wipe the outside clean. Step 4 -- Place the cup in the analyzer slot and close the lid. Step 5 -- Press TEST button. Step 6 -- Read the Fat, SNF, and other values on the display. Remember: always use the same sample volume for consistent results!

Common issues new users face: (1) Wrong readings -- usually because milk was not stirred well. Solution: use VIBRO stirrer for 10-15 seconds before testing. (2) Display not showing -- check power connection and adapter. (3) Error messages -- note the exact error code and contact support. (4) Printer not working -- check paper roll and connection. (5) Device not switching on -- verify adapter is working and fuse is intact. For any of these, I can give you detailed steps -- just ask!

Here are pro tips for the best testing results: (1) Always stir milk for 10-15 seconds before testing -- uneven milk gives wrong readings. (2) Use the correct sample volume -- too much or too little affects results. (3) Keep the analyzer clean -- wipe the cup and sensor area after every test. (4) Calibrate once every 15 days with standard liquid. (5) Test milk at room temperature -- very cold or hot milk may show different readings. (6) Replace cotton/filter regularly for consistent performance.
